records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6-day-old Starter account with no project, no invite, no key milestone and zero tickets; two Wrenfield emails (email:3a5d8cf1, email:deeec531) went unanswered, so no customer engagement signal at all. 8 days left, but silent, fully unstarted accounts rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: One quick step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

I don't want to crowd your inbox, so this is my last nudge for now. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is really the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather follow along there.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
